Card Q&A.a: Your opponent's target Digimon that was specified when the effect activated will continue to have the "[When Attacking] Lose 2 memory" effect until the end of your opponent's turn.
Card Q&A.q: "I used this card's [On Play] effect to give 1 of my opponent’s Digimon with the lowest level ""[When Attacking] Lose 2 memory."".Then, that opponent's Digimon digivolved and another Digimon became their Digimon with the lowest level. What happens to the ""[When Attacking] Lose 2 memory"" effect?"

Effect: [On Play] 1 of your opponent’s Digimon with the lowest level gains "[When Attacking] Lose 2 memory" until the end of your opponent's turn.
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞ (You may place this card under one of your Tamers.)
Inherited Effect: ＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
